name: HeyTurbine
original_description: Connect your HeyTurbine account to set up a brand in chat or reuse your saved brand profile, research and growth plan. Explore content ideas and a shortlist of relevant templates. Use your product photos or, after approval, illustrative visuals generated by Turbine to create videos, single images and carousels. Review and revise Turbine's script or outline before approving that exact draft for rendering. Change a finished creative as a new version of it, and choose who presents a video: Turbine's cast or a presenter you add from a photo, with that person's consent. Creation uses your account's available access and credits. When you explicitly request it, schedule or publish finished creatives to connected Instagram and TikTok accounts, update or cancel pending posts, and review available post performance.
